# Inference interventions

Observed inference interventions on the same checkpoints and Val-rep split; no retraining.

Component deltas compare K4 with y0; delta_none_A compares with none for the same seed and K.

Means require all three seeds; standard deviations use ddof=1. Missing runs are missing; partial aggregates are incomplete.
